title: Pure Voluntary Exchange
subject: Economics
caption: Two‑node voluntary exchange diagram illustrating mutual gains for both agents.
altText: A flowchart showing Agent A offering Goods and Agent B offering Services. Both agents trade these resources, indicated by arrows between Goods and Services, and a bidirectional arrow between the agents to denote voluntary exchange. The trade leads to higher utility for each agent and culminates in a win‑win outcome, with supporting nodes for the exchange process and outcomes.
